messages:
Lena Park: Quick async check — onboarding atlas-large-v2. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/atlas/atlas-large-v2/weights.tar.gz but staging agent reports a checksum mismatch. Also hitting a tokenizer quirk where some inputs produce a duplicated  token. Config lint fails on `max_sequence_length` vs `context_window`. Need help with: (1) confirm weights path/perms + full object, (2) quick tokenizer fix and test, (3) exact lint command to validate config, (4) a small golden prompt set for tool-calling / structured output regression. Pinging @Arjun @Samir @Serena @Maya — rapid replies appreciated.

Arjun Menon: Confirmed the S3 path exists and the service-account role has read access. Path: s3://redwood-models/atlas/atlas-large-v2/weights.tar.gz. Staging checksum mismatch looks like a partial upload — I see a partial object at 3.2GB; expected ~7.9GB. I'll re-upload the full tarball now with `aws s3 cp --no-progress` and verify md5. Also spotted a symlink in the package pointing to `../common/adapter.bin` — might be causing extraction mismatch in staging agent.

Samir Patel: The duplicate  token is usually from both `eos_token` and `sep_token` mapping to the same id in tokenizer.json. Quick patch: ensure special tokens map to unique strings/ids. Example change:
```
# tokenizer.json (excerpt)
"special_tokens": {
  "eos_token": "",
  "sep_token": "<|sep|>"
}
```
I'll open a tiny PR that (a) updates tokenizer.json, (b) adds a unit test asserting unique token ids, and (c) adds a small fuzz case for URLs (we've seen trailing slash trimming). Will ping when PR is up.

Serena Li: Lint command you want is:
`tools/model-lint --config configs/atlas-large-v2.yaml --strict`
It will fail if `max_sequence_length` > `context_window` or if there are incompatible quantization flags. If you're planning int8 quant, add `compatibility: {"quantization":"int8"}` in the config so lint knows it's expected. We should also enable `--check-special-tokens` while we're here.

deploy-bot: model-lint job failed: atlas-large-v2 / model-lint (staging) — exit code 1. See CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/atlas-large-v2/1234

Maya Gonzalez: For golden prompts / toolcall regression, start with these templates (they catch structured output regressions):
- `order_status`: "Given order id X, return JSON {\"status\":..., \"eta_minutes\":...}"
- `lookup_profile`: "Return profile JSON with fields {name, email, subscriptions} for user id Y"
- `math_chain`: "Show step-by-step work and return {\"result\": <number>}"
I'll upload a 50-example regression set to s3://redwood-evals/atlas/atlas-large-v2/golden-50.jsonl in ~10m. Use `eval-runner --model atlas-large-v2 --gold s3://redwood-evals/atlas/atlas-large-v2/golden-50.jsonl --check-structure --toolcall` to run the smoke regression.

Samir Patel: small note — tokenizer test added in PR also covers URL trailing-slash handling; fixed map for `<|sep|>` so it doesn't alias to eos id.

Arjun Menon: Re-upload in progress (started @ 2391234605). After upload finishes I'll kick a staging redeploy + model-lint + smoke toolcall. ETA ~30m assuming no issues.

Lena Park: Thanks — Samir, ping me when the PR is up and I'll review quickly. @Serena can you add the `--check-special-tokens` lint step into the staging CI so model-lint blocks deploys for this repo? Maya — drop the exact s3 link to the golden-50 once uploaded and I'll trigger eval-runner once staging is deployed. If needed we can do a 15m async sync later. :thumbsup:

Lena Park: Update: re-upload finished at 2391234801, I verified md5 locally. Samir's patch applied locally and `tools/model-lint --config configs/atlas-large-v2.yaml --strict --check-special-tokens` now passes. Last step is to run the `eval-runner` on staging cluster and confirm structured output toolcall smoke. Will post results here.
